title: RuntimeLogEvent
description: Safe structured runtime log shared by desktop, native host, and Python engine layers.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp ending in Z.

level.description: Severity name: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

layer.description: Runtime boundary that emitted the event: desktop, native, or engine.

component.description: Stable component identifier without machine-specific paths.

message.description: User-safe diagnostic that excludes source data and secrets.

correlation_id.description: UUID v7 joining events for one end-to-end operation.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence within the correlated runtime exchange.
